newsitem.title: USA: Calif. panel OKs $200 mln bond for boot camps.
newsitem.headline: Calif. panel OKs $200 mln bond for boot camps.

text.p: A California state legislative committee approved a bill on Tuesday that would place a $200 million bond measure on the ballot to build boot camps for young criminals, lawmakers said.
The Assembly Public Safety Committee voted 5-to-0 in favor of the bill, which now advances to the Assembly Appropriations Committee for review.

Assembly Bill 1118, by Assembly Speaker Cruz Bustamante, would place a bond measure on the statewide ballot to provide $200 million in state matching funds for counties wishing to operate the boot camps.
